mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.apt_no, a.warehouse_id, a.apt_date, a.apt_slot, a.task_type, a.plate_no, a.driver_name, a.container_no, a.status FROM yms_appointment a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND a.apt_date = #{aptDate} AND a.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'NO_SHOW') ORDER BY a.apt_slot ASC
